name: agentry
description: Find, verify, install and run QuickAgents (signed, scanned agent packages with a declared capability contract) and build your own, from your agent host.

interface.longDescription: Agentry brings QuickAgents into your agent host. Search a registry, read a QuickAgent's capability contract, scan findings and signature, install it, and run it in Agentry's sandboxed runner with a preview you approve first. Build your own QuickAgent, validate it, get an AI Review and test it before you publish. The plugin drives the Agentry CLI on your computer; the CLI keeps your sign-in and enforces each QuickAgent's contract.
